_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for Ocean City, MD. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md.

deals.name: Alley Oops (Midtown and Uptown)
deals.details: Sunday special at both locations. Wednesdays bring half-price games.

deals.name: Alley Oops Midtown
deals.details: Half-price bowling Monday through Thursday (closed Tuesdays at Midtown). Dine-in specials exclude holidays and special event weekends.

deals.name: Ocean City Life-Saving Station Museum
deals.deal: Kids 11 and under free; $10 two-museum pass
deals.details: Admission is $6 per museum; a $10 pass covers one entry to both the Life-Saving Station Museum and the Museum of Ocean City within a week. November-April hours are Saturday and Sunday, 10 AM-1:30 PM.

deals.name: Winterfest of Lights
deals.deal: Free admission for kids 11 and under
deals.details: Holiday light show at Northside Park, November 19, 2026 to January 2, 2027. Admission is $6 (plus fees) for guests 12 and older; children 11 and younger are free.

deals.name: Alley Oops (Midtown and Uptown)
deals.deal: NFL game specials: $3 Natural Lights, $3 Miller Lite bottles, $5 Yuengling drafts
deals.details: During every NFL game: Monday and Thursday at the bar only, Sunday at tables and bar. Half-price wings and egg rolls are included.

deals.name: Alley Oops Midtown
deals.deal: $2.50 Miller bottles; $2 off drafts, crushes, rails and house wine
deals.details: Happy hour at tables and bar, Monday-Friday 2-6 PM. The Uptown location (13101 Coastal Highway) runs the same happy hour Monday-Friday 4-6 PM.

deals.name: Hooked
deals.details: Off-season Friday special on select bottles of wine.

deals.name: Nantuckets
deals.details: Wine Wednesdays: $10 off bottles of wine.

deals.name: Alley Oops Midtown
deals.deal: Daily food specials, including half-price entrees on Mondays
deals.details: Monday half-price entrees; Wednesday half-price quesadillas; Thursday half-price smash burgers (sides and toppings extra); Friday one appetizer, one entree and a $10 game card for $35; Sunday half-price appetizers. Dine-in only; excludes holidays and special event weekends. Closed Tuesdays.

deals.name: Fager's Island
deals.details: Half-price prime rib on Sundays and Mondays, starting November 15, 2026. The restaurant opens daily at 11 AM.

deals.name: Hooked
deals.details: Off-season special Monday through Thursday. Sundays bring a $25 three-course meal, dine-in only. Open daily 4:30-9 PM.

deals.name: Nantuckets
deals.details: $29 entree selections every Sunday, Wednesday and Thursday, dine-in only.

deals.name: Seacrets
deals.details: Half-price entrees Thursday and Sunday, 4-9 PM. Seacrets is open Thursday through Sunday in the off-season.

deals.name: Seacrets
deals.deal: Two jerk chicken tacos for $8; half-price jerk chicken, Jamaican fries and steamed shrimp
deals.details: Both specials run Thursday and Sunday, 4-7 PM.
